payload.title: Slow responses in a canary release
Slow responses in a canary release
payload.description: The canary found it: latency. v0.9.9 rolled back at 25% before a step was measured. Triage opened a ticket.
payload.story: v0.9.9 carried none of the factory’s work: it was Martin’s own commits. Three minutes into its 25% step, the canary’s latency failed its second look against v0.9.8, and Argo Rollouts sent all the traffic back. Prometheus had no requests from the canary to compare, so the analysis kept no series and could name no route. A rollback is a signal: the line left triage the failed measure, and triage opened this ticket with it.
